tool_config.name: find_jobs
tool_config.description: Look up the Job the Foreman named. Call it as soon as the Foreman names a Job, with their words. Returns up to three matching active Jobs as [{"job_id": 14, "name": "Route 104 Widening", "score": 95}], best first. An empty list [] means no Job matches: the Job is Unmatched. Returns {"error": "..."} if the Job list could not be searched.

request_body_schema.description: The Job as the Foreman said it.

query.description: The Job exactly as the Foreman said it, for example 'the 104 job' or 'Penfield'.
